item.title: Re: Favorite video game quotes?
item.content:encoded:
"From the moment I understood the weakness of my flesh, it disgusted me.
I craved the strength and certainty of steel. I aspired to the purity of the blessed machine.
Your kind cling to your flesh as if it will not decay and fail you.
One day the crude biomass that you called a temple will wither, and you'll beg my kind to save you.
But I am already saved. For the machine is immortal.
Even in death I serve the Omnissiah."

-Magos Dominus Reditus, Warhammer 40,000: Mechanicus

The voice acting of Warhammer games is pretty much stellar all around, but that little speech at the beginning of Mechanicus is on another level imo. The whole sound design of that game is amazing, tbh.

However, my favorite quotes at this moment are from Disco Elysium, but they are a pretty spoilery, so I'll refrain from posting them.

"My country lay within a vast desert. When the sun rose into the sky, a burning wind punished my lands, searing the world. And when the moon climbed into the dark of night, a frigid gale pierced our homes. No matter when it came, the wind carried the same thing… Death. But the winds that blew across the green fields of Hyrule brought something other than suffering and ruin. I coveted that wind, I suppose."

- Ganondorf, The Windwaker

item.title: Re: Favorite video game quotes?
item.content:encoded:
Less seriously, and also from Hollow Knight,

Water is refreshing, but if you try to breathe it you are in for a nasty shock.

- Zote the Mighty, Precept 44, “You Can Not Breathe Water”

More seriously,

These petals… so white. Can you see them too… watching me from wherever you are?
Perhaps dreams aren't such bad things after all…

- Elderbug’s inner monologue

Context (some spoilers):

+ show block
– hide block

This is the Dream Nail (lets you read minds and accrue extra SOUL (mana equivalent), as well as bust ghosts and invade dreams) monologue for Elderbug (first NPC encountered in-game, in Dirtmouth), after you give him a Delicate Flower (quest item to be delivered over the course of a grueling no-hit trek across Hallownest (setting of Hollow Knight) to the Traitor Lord’s Daughter’s grave in order to help the Grey Mourner move on and get a Mask Shard (Piece of Heart equivalent)). Elderbug is surprised and grateful as a result of this action, now having a lighter outlook on life. Arguably one of the most heartwarming things you can do in Hollow Knight.

item.title: Re: Favorite video game quotes?
item.content:encoded:
Upon waking up with a hangover and trying to retrieve a necktie from a ceiling fan:

“[Inland Empire: medium success] Has it been consigned there as punishment? You feel as though this creature is your friend and wants to reattach itself to your neck.”
“[Logic: medium success] If it’s your friend, why was it up there? Who ties their friend to a ceiling fan? Perhaps this thing is dangerous.”

- Disco Elysium

“Our futures are murky. Let's not be too friendly, now.”

“Men develop the most peculiar fascinations. Sometimes their fascinations seem to take control. Till there's very little man left.”

“The fast fading Flame must be linked to preserve this world. A re-enactment of the first linking of the fire. So it is, I became a Lord of Cinder. I may be but small, but I will die a colossus.”

- Dark Souls series

“Where's the fun without complications?”

“Man, you guys give me the heebie-jeebies. Sounds like you know a lot more about somethin' than you're supposed to. Lucky for you, you probably don't understand what you're sayin'.”

- Vampire the Masquerade: Bloodlines

item.title: Re: Favorite video game quotes?
item.content:encoded:
I have a few, serious or otherwise.

"Who did you expect to find at the end of all this? God? The devil, perhaps? No, it's just… me." - ████████████, DUSK

Literally anything Gorgutz says in the Dawn of War expansions.

"If doubts and curiosity plague you, you're skinning your knuckles on the wrong door." - Durance, Pillars of Eternity

"Look at this: just caved in your skull, my bat's still dry. No clumps of hair, nuthin'." - Scout, Team Fortress 2

"We had created monsters we couldn't control. We drugged them, tortured them, eviscerated them… we brutalized their minds, but it did not work. Until they came. And it was not their force of will, not their Void devilry, not their alien darkness… it was something else. It was that somehow, from within the derelict-horror, they had learned a way to see inside an ugly broken thing…and take away its pain." - Ballas, Warframe
